parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which jobs were submitted. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 任务提交时间起始范围，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The end of the time range during which jobs were submitted. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 任务提交时间结束范围，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
fields.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The range of start time. You can filter jobs whose start time falls within the specified time range
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间范围，过滤开始时间在一个时间范围内的任务
parameters.name: start_range

fields.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which jobs ended. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 任务结束时间起始范围，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The end of the time range during which jobs ended. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 任务结束时间结束范围，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
fields.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The range of end time. You can filter jobs whose end time falls within the specified time range
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间范围，过滤出结束时间在一个时间范围内的任务
parameters.name: end_range

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the jobs that are submitted to YARN
parameters.help_zh: 任务提交到YARN的IDs，用于过滤任务列表
parameters.name: app_ids

parameters.help_en: The users who submit the jobs
parameters.help_zh: 任务提交的用户列表，用于过滤任务列表
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The YARN queues to which the jobs are submitted
parameters.help_zh: 任务提交到YARN的队列列表，用于过滤任务列表
parameters.name: queues

parameters.help_en: The YARN engines to which the jobs are submitted
parameters.help_zh: 任务提交到YARN的引擎列表，用于过滤任务列表
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

*   ASC: the ascending order
*   DESC: the descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：

- ASC： 升序排列。
- DESC：降序排列
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The field that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

*   vcoreSeconds: the aggregated number of vCPUs that are allocated to the job multiplied by the number of seconds the job has been running
*   memSeconds: the aggregated amount of memory that is allocated to the job multiplied by the number of seconds the job has been running
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值：

- vcoreSeconds：任务CPU使用量。
- memSeconds：任务内存使用量
parameters.name: order_by
